title: Meta launches an outbound calling feature for Muse, such as to businesses, available for paid US subscribers; Gemini and startup Instinct offer a similar option (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
summary: Sarah Perez / TechCrunch: Meta launches an outbound calling feature for Muse, such as to businesses, available for paid US subscribers; Gemini and startup Instinct offer a similar option — After initially testing the feature in September, Meta's consumer AI agent Muse is now able to place calls to U.S. businesses on behalf of its users.
